create_UniSINDataset: create a UniSINDataset instance with data_path, filenames, height, width, frame_idxs, num_scales, and is_train parameters
get_color_UniSINDataset: get a color image from a given file path with optional left-right flip using UniSINDataset.get_color
get_depth_UniSINDataset: get a depth ground truth map from a given file path with optional left-right flip using UniSINDataset.get_depth
review_UniSINDataset_init: review the UniSINDataset __init__ to understand normalized camera intrinsics matrix K and full resolution shape
summarize_UniSINDataset: summarize the UniSINDataset class which loads UniSIN dataset color images and depth maps for monocular depth estimation
